corpusFingerprintMeaning: Canonical digest of frozen old/new normalized corpus digests; splitSha256 identifies the entire frozen expanded plan.

protocol.averaging: Macro: each tested journal equally; micro: each untouched held-out paper equally.
protocol.denominator: Full catalog; unsupported labels, unembeddable papers and abstentions count as misses.
protocol.historicalTestRole: Regression-only; excluded from main metrics and quality gate.

coverage.actualTestFractionDenominator: New unseen eligible components before temporal-boundary quarantine

newAcquisition.selection: Newest-first annual prefix, not random and not exhaustive for high-volume journals.
newAcquisition.holdoutUniverse: Previously unseen OA-indexed papers; license-unrestricted only within this OA acquisition universe.

samplingStrategy.historicalCorpus: Previously seen, varied-license corpus; historical inspected test is reported separately as regression only.
samplingStrategy.reuse: OA status and author attribution do not establish reuse rights. Documentary CC BY, CC0 or public-domain permission is separately required for fitting and public indexing.

comparisons.uncertaintyCaution: Exploratory journal-cluster intervals; no multiple-comparison correction.

notApplicableChecks.name: old-scope-baseline
notApplicableChecks.reason: The declared baseline is the previous corpus-trained model; all other applicable app thresholds are retained.

missingEvidence: No verified component ablation is available.
qualityGate.ablationStatus: Not evaluated by this expanded benchmark; no ablation evidence is claimed.
qualityGate.claim: Experimental only. These results do not establish broad superiority or production readiness.

privacy: Aggregate benchmark statistics only; no paper-level test identifiers, predictions, queries or abstracts.
limitations: Known publication venue is not acceptance probability or exclusive suitability.

New acquisition uses OPEN_ACCESS:Y, English research/review papers, and up to 1000 newest papers per journal per year in 2021-2026. Annual prefixes are not random or exhaustive for high-volume journals.
The untouched holdout measures unseen OA-indexed papers, not general publication or paywalled-paper performance. Test inclusion is license-unrestricted only within that OA sampling universe.
The older varied-license corpus was previously seen; historical test results are regression-only, never main metrics or readiness evidence.
OA status and authorship alone are not training or redistribution permission; documentary reuse rights are checked separately.
Adapter reuse-documentation checks cover public-index citations only; omitted training citations are not re-audited here.
Temporal cutoffs differ by journal; frozen encoder pretraining overlap is unknown.
This adapter checks recorded artifacts and memberships; it does not rerun or independently reproduce evaluation.
